title: Hearty Smoky German White Beans Grill
description: A sweet and energizing German dish featuring dried white beans, bonito-shave, and a cheese-pull, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the soaked and drained white beans, diced smoked bacon, chopped onion, and minced garlic.
In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, olive oil, salt, and black pepper, and pour the mixture over the white bean mixture.
Stir in the shaved bonito flakes and shredded gruyere cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a grill-safe dish and place it on the preheated binchotan grill.
Close the grill lid and cook for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the grill and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Hearty Smoky German White Beans Grill hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
